items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: That's where I first met her, at...was it UCLA? We rehearsed at UCLA.

ctx.x: Herman McCoy used to lead a singing group. That's where I first met her, at...was it UCLA? We rehearsed at UCLA. We rehearsed with June Christy, Buddy Collette again, Nelson Riddle and myself -- somehow we were featured with this group. Nelson had the band, because he had already quit playing trombone, he was just writing. But we were the featured artists along with Herman McCoy and this group, and Mary Lou was a member of the group. That's where I first met her.
